# vyos.blueprints.ospf

OSPFv2 routing

- General OSPFv2 building block - router-id, areas, per-interface settings, redistribution with access-list export filters, and an import route-map that controls which OSPF routes are installed.
- Used by the "High Availability Walkthrough" blueprint (OSPF over WireGuard). For the "OSPF unnumbered with ECMP" design use `vyos.blueprints.ospf_unnumbered`.
- Uses vyos_ospfv2 and vyos_ospf_interfaces; the access-list export filters, bare `log-adjacency-changes` and `system ip protocol ospf route-map` use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because the modules cannot express them yet.
- Create referenced access-lists and route-maps first, e.g. with `vyos.blueprints.route_policy`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.ospf
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ospf_router_id` | str |  | `''` | OSPF router-id. Nothing is configured when this, `ospf_areas` and `ospf_interfaces` are all empty. |
| `ospf_areas` | list |  | `[]` | Areas. |
| `ospf_areas.id` | str | yes |  | Area id, e.g. `0.0.0.0`. |
| `ospf_areas.networks` | list |  | `[]` | Networks in the area. |
| `ospf_areas.authentication` | str |  |  | Area authentication. |
| `ospf_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Per-interface settings. |
| `ospf_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | Interface, e.g. `wg01`. |
| `ospf_interfaces.network` | str |  |  | Network type, e.g. `point-to-point`. |
| `ospf_interfaces.cost` | int |  |  | Interface cost. |
| `ospf_interfaces.priority` | int |  |  | DR priority. |
| `ospf_interfaces.hello_interval` | int |  |  | Hello interval in seconds. |
| `ospf_interfaces.dead_interval` | int |  |  | Dead interval in seconds. |
| `ospf_interfaces.retransmit_interval` | int |  |  | Retransmit interval in seconds. |
| `ospf_interfaces.transmit_delay` | int |  |  | Transmit delay in seconds. |
| `ospf_interfaces.passive` | bool |  |  | `true` - do not form adjacencies; `false` - `passive disable`, i.e. form adjacencies despite `ospf_passive_interface_default`. |
| `ospf_interfaces.area` | str |  |  | Put the interface into this area (`interface <if> area`), instead of a network statement. |
| `ospf_interfaces.md5_key` | str |  |  | MD5 authentication key. |
| `ospf_interfaces.md5_key_id` | int |  | `1` | MD5 key id. |
| `ospf_redistribute` | list |  | `[]` | Redistribution into OSPF. |
| `ospf_redistribute.type` | str | yes |  | Route type, e.g. `connected`, `static`, `bgp`. |
| `ospf_redistribute.metric` | int |  |  | Metric. |
| `ospf_redistribute.route_map` | str |  |  | Route-map applied to redistributed routes. |
| `ospf_redistribute_access_lists` | dict |  | `{}` | Access-list export filter per redistributed route type, e.g. `{connected: 150}`. |
| `ospf_reference_bandwidth` | int |  |  | Auto-cost reference bandwidth in Mbit/s. |
| `ospf_abr_type` | str |  | `''` | ABR type, e.g. `cisco`. |
| `ospf_passive_interface_default` | bool |  | `false` | Make all interfaces passive by default (`passive-interface default`). |
| `ospf_log_adjacency_changes` | bool |  | `false` | Log adjacency changes. |
| `ospf_import_route_map` | str |  | `''` | Route-map deciding which OSPF routes are installed (`system ip protocol ospf route-map`). |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks a Full adjacency on every interface that forms adjacencies.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ospf_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `ospf_passive_interface_default` | bool |  | `false` | Same value as for `main`. |
